entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
Yeah, I have it. I need to make a return.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help...
I just said, a return. Order number is VF7781-90. Just tell me yes or no, can I return these shoes?

Of course, one moment while I pull that up for you. Okay, I see the order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. To get this sorted out quickly, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit right. I adjusted the cleats multiple times and they still gave me blisters after my last ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear they were uncomfortable. Getting blisters is definitely no good. Let me just confirm the return eligibility. I see the delivery was 42 days ago.

So, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you. I'm authorizing the refund right now and have just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file.
Okay, I see the email. Finally. That's all I needed.
I understand you're busy, and I also see you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble with the cycling shoes, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
A credit? Fine. Thanks, I guess. That's it, then.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
